Name: dynein complex
Any of several large complexes that contain two or three dynein heavy chains and several light chains, and have microtubule motor activity.

Name: aggresome Charge: 0
An inclusion body formed by dynein-dependent retrograde transport of an aggregated protein on microtubules.
